The name Musarraf therefore, conjures feelings of wealth, allure, and success in one's personal and professional ventures.

historical_references.reference: Musabh-i-Mausam, the Persian name of Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah, the last independent ruler of the Qutb Shahi dynasty in the Deccan. His name in Persian means 'the prince of the monsoon'. The monsoon season brought prosperity and wealth to the region during his reign from 1580 to 1612 CE.
historical_references.context: Qutb Shahi Dynasty, Deccan region, India

historical_references.reference: Mirza Rukn-ud-Din Firoz Shah, also known as Musarraf Khan, was a Mughal general and governor. He ruled the Mughal Empire as regent for the young emperor Shah Jahan from 1627 to 1632 CE. During this period, he successfully defended against invading forces, including the Safavids, and expanded the Mughal empire's territories.
